{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify the deduplication worked
print(f'Number of unique patients after deduplication: {len(df_dedup)}')

# Confirm this matches the expected unique count
print(f'Expected unique patient count: {df["patient_id"].nunique()}')"}
